name: Turlough Convery
bio: Turlough Convery is an Irish actor. Convery grew up in Northern Ireland and attended Rockport School, and Our Lady and St Patrick’s college, Knockwhere he received a number of prizes for Drama.

credits.title: Sense and Sensibility
credits.overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

credits.title: The Damned
credits.overview: A 19th-century widow has to make an impossible choice when, during an especially cruel winter, a foreign ship sinks off the coast of her Icelandic fishing village.

credits.title: Belfast
credits.overview: Buddy is a young boy on the cusp of adolescence, whose life is filled with familial love, childhood hijinks, and a blossoming romance. Yet, with his beloved hometown caught up in increasing turmoil, his family faces a momentous choice: hope the conflict will pass or leave everything they know behind for a new life.

credits.title: Pixie
credits.overview: To avenge her mother's death, Pixie masterminds a heist but must flee across Ireland from gangsters, take on the patriarchy, and choose her own destiny.

credits.title: Saint Maud
credits.overview: Having recently found God, self-effacing young nurse Maud arrives at a plush home to care for Amanda, a hedonistic dancer left frail from a chronic illness. When a chance encounter with a former colleague throws up hints of a dark past, it becomes clear there is more to sweet Maud than meets the eye.

credits.title: Doing Money
credits.overview: A young Romanian woman is snatched in broad daylight from a London street, trafficked to Ireland and used as a sex slave in a series of pop-up brothels. Her shocking true story offers a tense and thought-provoking thriller exposing how, in modern Britain, slavery can hide in plain sight.

credits.title: Ready Player One
credits.overview: When the creator of a popular video game system dies, a virtual contest is created to compete for his fortune.

credits.title: Dragonheart: Battle for the Heartfire

credits.title: A Quiet Passion
credits.overview: The story of American poet Emily Dickinson from her early days as a young schoolgirl to her later years as a reclusive, unrecognized artist.
